en: The producer's tree measured 81 MB in 3083 files on 2026-09-24 at <t1/> — the pages rustdoc wrote, the landing page and <t2/>, summed by byte size — and the pages embed the values of the crate's <t3/> and <t4/> constants: rustdoc renders <t5/> on the constant's page. Committed, the tree would be stale on every commit that touched the crate, and on every commit at all through that one page, and would put its whole size into every clone. It is generated in CI instead: by a <t6/> job of its own in <t7/>, not by steps of the deploy job, which hands the tree to the deploy job as an artifact of the same run; and the validation workflow's jobs that build the site obtain it through the same composite action, <t8/>, so the two workflows cannot build it differently. The deploy job needs the <t9/> job, so the two run one after the other: the site's build composes the tree and the site's checks judge the composed output, so neither can start before the tree exists.

Commitnutý by strom byl zastaralý při každém commitu, který se crate dotkl, a skrze tu jednu stránku při každém commitu vůbec, a vložil by celou svou velikost do každého klonu. en: Every fact this repository shows had been reduced to one declaration and many projections: a capability is declared once and reaches MCP, HTTP, OpenAPI, the command line, the Cockpit and the generated reference without any of them holding a definition (ADR 2, ADR 4, ADR 5); an object of the layer is a file, and every surface that shows it is derived (ADR 7, ADR 8, ADR 18); a web surface is discovered from its producer and resolved once (ADR 13). One property of a collection had never been through that reduction, and it is the one a person sees first: the sequence.
cs: Každý fakt, který tento repozitář ukazuje, byl zredukován na jednu deklaraci a mnoho projekcí: schopnost se deklaruje jednou a dosáhne MCP, HTTP, OpenAPI, příkazové řádky, Cockpitu i generované reference, aniž by kterákoli držela definici (ADR 2, ADR 4, ADR 5); objekt vrstvy je soubor a každý povrch, který ho ukazuje, je odvozen (ADR 7, ADR 8, ADR 18); webový povrch se objevuje od svého producenta a rozpoznává se jednou (ADR 13). Jedna vlastnost kolekce touto redukcí nikdy neprošla a je to ta, kterou člověk vidí jako první: pořadí.
